title: Superpower
description: Clinical zinc on white: near-black ink, zinc-500 secondary text, zinc-50 bands and zinc-100 soft fills, hairline zinc-200 borders, with a sparing vermillion for the brand CTA and its orange glow. One regular-weight grotesk for everything, a geometric mono for step numbers, 12px radii and full pills. Dark mode is a zinc-950 sibling with the same vermillion.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the superpower photo bands (hero, closer, offer) force the dark class on themselves
headings are weight 400: blocks set font-normal on them, so a theme with a heavier display face still reads as intended
highlight and glow are the warm amber used for button glows and the photo-band placeholders
name: superpower-theme
